transcript.text: tell me when any product's stock goes below 5

I'll watch your Shopify stock list and flag any product-variant whose available quantity (what's actually sellable, not just on-hand) drops below 5 — you'll see it as an alert plus a standing low-stock view sorted worst-first, with a count on top. Items Shopify doesn't track stock for won't be counted, since their zero isn't a real shortage. Right now, for example, Silk Saree (Main warehouse) is at 0 and Cotton Kurta S (Mumbai store) at 2. Quick check: do you want the below-5 rule applied per location, or on the product's total across locations? And should it alert once or keep reminding daily while low? Want me to build it?
Add them all up across locations, one alert is enough. Sounds good, build it.

I'll build a Stock section that totals each variant's available quantity across all locations and alerts you daily once any drops below 5.
A Stock section mirroring your Shopify inventory, with each variant's available quantity added up across Main warehouse and Mumbai store, flagged Low once the combined total drops below 5, with a daily check that alerts you to it.
[A design, with a Build button:]
